caption: The drawing features three distinct metallic objects, each rendered in shades of brown and gray, suggestive of aged or tarnished metal. The first object, located near the upper center, consists of a curved strip forming a loop at the top, attached to a horizontal component with a hinge or clamp mechanism, and ending with a small cup-shaped bowl on an arm extending to the right. Below this, the second object is oriented vertically; it has a similar cup-shaped bowl attached to a horizontal arm about halfway down, a tapered shaft, and a decorative, flared base at the bottom. This object also features a screw mechanism on the shaft, with a teardrop-shaped finial. At the lower left, a smaller, rectangular metallic object is depicted, resembling a bracket or clamp, colored in lighter gray with visible bolts and a central threaded component. The objects are arranged on an off-white background, spaced apart and not overlapping.
title: Sewing Bird
